vocabulary.resolved-rendered: At least one matching provider is a rendered object or rendered CRD capability.
vocabulary.resolved-runtime: A rendered controller contract declares the output, but this graph does not prove that a controller materialized it.
vocabulary.external: The dependency is intentionally outside the rendered Kubernetes object set.
vocabulary.target-prerequisite: The reference is to a well-known target-cluster object outside this aggregate render; presence is not observed here.
vocabulary.optional-unprovided: The rendered reference is explicitly optional and has no provider in the aggregate render.
vocabulary.unresolved: No matching provider declaration exists in the prepared aggregate render.
vocabulary.ambiguous: More than one component declares an exact provider where one owner is expected.
